mapper.select: select PGM_ID ,PGM_NM ,PGM_DESC ,PGM_URL ,REC_ST ,REG_ID ,REG_DT ,UPD_ID ,UPD_DT from JCMS_PGM where DEL_DT IS NULL and PGM_ID = #{pgmId}

select PGM_ID ,PGM_NM ,PGM_DESC ,PGM_URL ,REC_ST ,REG_ID ,REG_DT ,UPD_ID ,UPD_DT from JCMS_PGM where DEL_DT IS NULL and REC_ST = #{recSt} and PGM_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pgmNmLike}, '%') and PGM_URL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pgmUrlLike}, '%') order by ${sort} ${sortOrd} limit #{start}, #{length}
select COUNT(PGM_ID) from JCMS_PGM where DEL_DT IS NULL and PGM_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pgmNmLike}, '%') and PGM_URL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pgmUrlLike}, '%')
